title: fix(plugin-dashboard): the editable grid's object-bound table fetches its rows, and its object-bound pivot shows the retired-widget placeholder (objectui#10528)
body:
Fixes #10528

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The editable `dashboard-grid` (`DashboardGridLayout`) turned a table-family widget whose data is `{ provider: 'object', object }` into a static `data-table` node. That node had `data: []` and an `objectName` that `data-table` never reads. So the tile drew an empty table and sent no query. `DashboardRenderer` turns the same stored widget into `object-data-table`, which fetches its rows.

The grid's table arm now emits the same node `DashboardRenderer`'s table arm emits, prop for prop:

| Prop | Grid before | Grid now (same as the renderer) |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `data-table` | `object-data-table` |
| `data` | `[]` | not set (the node fetches) |
| `filter` | not set | the provider's `filter`, else the widget's `filter` |
| `searchable` / `pagination` | always `false` | `widget.searchable ?? false` / `widget.pagination ?? false`; always `false` on a `list` |
| `drillDown` | not set | `options.drillDown ?? { enabled: true, mode: 'record' }` |
| `objectName`, `className`, and the `...options` spread without `data` | unchanged | unchanged |

Files changed, round 1 (the table half):

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx`: only the `provider: 'object'` branch of the table arm;
- one new pin file;
- one changeset.

Rounds 2 and 3 (below) add the pivot half and two prose corrections: at the head the PR changes six files. `DashboardGridLayout.tsx`'s provider-object pivot branch, `DashboardRenderer.tsx`'s pivot-arm comment (comment only), the 7353 pin's grid-pivot row and the pending `7353` changeset's prose all move. These stay byte-unchanged: the static-data branches of the table and pivot arms.

## drillDown on the editable grid: kept on by default, as on the renderer

I measured this with a one-off probe on the fixed tree, in "Edit Layout" mode. The probe was not committed.

happy-dom gives the grid a zero width and a null `offsetParent`, and react-grid-layout's drag start returns early without an `offsetParent`. So the probe stubbed both. In the first two runs, without those stubs, the positive control did not fire either, so I discarded those readings.

| Probe leg | Reading |
|---|---|
| drag handle rendered in edit mode | true |
| row cell is inside `.drag-handle` | false |
| press and move on the row cell starts a drag (`react-draggable-dragging`) | false |
| press and move on the drag handle starts a drag (positive control) | true |
| row click opens the record drawer (`record-detail-body`) | true |

On the grid, a drag can start only from `dragConfig.handle: '.drag-handle'`. The grid also has no widget selection: there is no `onWidgetClick` or `selectedWidgetId`, unlike `DashboardRenderer`'s design mode. So a row click cannot start a drag or a selection, and the renderer's default stays as it is. There is no difference to pin, and the parity pin keeps the two nodes equal.

## Round 1: the provider-object pivot arm stopped at the decision

I measured the dispatch's pivot hypothesis, and the pivot half stops here:

- `object-pivot` (`ObjectPivotTable`) exists and is registered. It fetches through `objectName` and `filter`, then cross-tabs the rows client-side over `rowField` / `columnField` / `valueField` / `aggregation`. It reads no provider `aggregate`.
- Mapping the grid's pivot arm to it would contradict ADR-0021 in the tree's own words:
  - `widgetDispatch.ts` documents the family as "Cross-tab — dataset-bound only; a non-dataset pivot is stale metadata."
  - `DashboardRenderer`'s pivot arm answers every non-dataset pivot with `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA`.
  - The spec's widget guidance set `LEGACY_WIDGET_ANALYTICS_KEYS` names `rowField` / `columnField` / `valueField` / `aggregation` as part of the removed pre-ADR-0021 inline analytics shape.

Round 1 left that arm untouched and took the question to the card, analysed on the four axes. The seat decided it (option B) in the amended claim `5831757648`; round 2 below carries it out.

## Round 2 (claim `5831757648`, head `7a4f697`)

The seat took option B for the pivot half (amended claim `5831757648`): the grid's `provider: 'object'` pivot arm is retired, the same answer the read dashboard gives (ADR-0021).
- `DashboardGridLayout.tsx`: the pivot arm's provider-object branch returns `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA`, imported from `./legacyRetiredWidget` (the renderer's own source; no second copy). The static-data pivot branch is byte-unchanged.
- `DashboardRenderer.tsx`: comment only (0 non-comment lines). The pivot-arm comment now says the grid still draws static-data pivots and answers the provider-object pivot with the same placeholder.
- `widgetDataProviderRetired-7353.test.tsx`: the grid-pivot row that pinned the removed branch is replaced by a row pinning the placeholder (identity), with no `find` call, citing the claim.
- New pins in `DashboardGridLayout.objectProviderFetch-10528.test.tsx`: an object-provider pivot on the grid renders the placeholder and calls no `find`; the grid and `DashboardRenderer` hand `SchemaRenderer` the same placeholder object for the same widget. The static-data table and pivot lit controls and all table-half pins stay green.
- Reverse verification: with `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` at the round-2 base, `Tests 3 failed | 12 passed (15)` (exit 1; exactly the three pivot cases); at `7a4f697`, `Tests 15 passed (15)` (exit 0).
- Producer census re-measured with a quote-agnostic pattern and positive controls: still zero provider-object pivot producers in either tree.
- Gates on `7a4f697`: the plugin-dashboard suite plus 13 cross-package readers (143 files, 1712 tests, exit 0); `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` (exit 0); eslint (0 errors, no new warnings); the control-byte, test-path, vi-mock, line-citation and changeset gates (exit 0 each); `check-governed-queue-guard` NOT GOVERNED. CI: 43 check-runs, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failed.
- The changeset now covers both halves and stays `patch`.

## Pins

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardGridLayout.objectProviderFetch-10528.test.tsx` held 8 tests in round 1; round 2 adds the two pivot cases (10 at the head):

- **Grid, provider-object table.** The node is `object-data-table`, with `objectName: 'account'` and no `dataProvider`. The adapter's `find` is called, and only for `account`. The rows it returns (`Acme`, `Globex`) are on screen.
- **Grid, filter.** The provider's `filter` reaches `find` as `$filter`.
- **Parity, over 4 widgets.** For each widget, the node the grid composes `toEqual`s the node `DashboardRenderer` composes. The widgets: a plain table; a table with a provider filter, `searchable`, `pagination` and `columns`; a `list` with `searchable` and `pagination` authored; a table with an authored `drillDown`.
- **Lit controls.** On the grid, a static-data table and a static-data pivot draw their authored rows, compose `data-table` / `pivot`, and never call `find`.

Red, then green, run from the committed state. The script is trap-guarded. The restore is proven by the file's blob hash equalling `HEAD`'s and by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| Tree | Pin result | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` at base `e5f4343` | 6 failed, 2 passed (the two lit controls). First failure: "Unable to find an element with the text: Acme" | 1 |
| `HEAD` `6e9abea` | 8 passed | 0 |

## Gates, on `6fce3f1` (after merging `origin/main` at `caf0ed0`)

- **Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/`, plus the 9 test files outside the package that render or read the grid: 139 files (130 package files + 9), 1562 tests passed, exit 0.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard --concurrency=2`: 14/14 tasks, exit 0. The package task was a cache miss and ran both `tsc` legs, and `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin.
- **eslint** on the 2 changed files: 0 errors, exit 0. See Acceptance notes.
- **Check gates**, each at exit 0 with its own verdict line clean:
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new; report-only)
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 3 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **eslint narrowing.**
  - `--format json` counts 2 files linted.
  - The grid file has the same 7 warnings, by rule, on base and head.
  - The new pin adds 2 `no-explicit-any` warnings, in the listener mock copied from `widgetDataProviderRetired-7353.test.tsx`. This repo deliberately leaves `--max-warnings` unset.
  - Type-aware linting is not enabled, and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads other files. So this diff cannot change the lint verdict of any file it does not touch.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **The 7353 pin's grid table row.** In `widgetDataProviderRetired-7353.test.tsx`, the grid table row still passes. It now reads the `data-table` node that `ObjectDataTable` renders onward, not a node the grid composes. The new pin checks that the grid's own `object-data-table` node carries no `dataProvider`. The row's name ("becomes a data-table node") now describes that onward node. That table row is left as it is; round 2 edits only the file's grid-pivot row, which the amended claim `5831757648` brought into the surface.
- **The pending 7353 changeset.** Round 2 made its sentence about the grid's `data-table` / `pivot` nodes false (the grid now builds `object-data-table` for a provider-object table and the retired-widget placeholder for a provider-object pivot). The prose round (`3e3c9ae`, seat-authorized) rewrote those two sentences so each reads true at the head; its front matter is byte-identical.
- **Changeset name.** It is `10528-grid-object-table-fetch.md`, not the dispatched `10528-grid-object-table-pivot-fetch.md`; the name dates from round 1. It now covers both halves, and it is kept as is because the presence gate passes with it.
- **The grid's `dataSource` prop.** The grid hands its `dataSource` prop to `DatasetWidget` only. The `object-*` nodes it composes, the new table node included, read the adapter from `SchemaRendererContext`. `DashboardRenderer` also passes its prop to each child `SchemaRenderer`. Not measured as reachable: no host in this repo mounts the grid outside a provider. Carrier: none. Noted, not filed.
- **`DashboardRenderer`'s pivot-arm comment.** It says the grid "does still draw pivots from static data and from the `provider: 'object'` config". In effect, the second half has been false: the grid draws an empty pivot and sends no query. This belongs to the pivot decision.
- **Docs.** No README or `content/docs` statement covers the grid's object-bound tables (checked by grepping for `dashboard-grid` and `DashboardGridLayout`), so no doc edit is owed.
